svg.title: 2. Governance with Lake Formation
svg.text: Who can read what: Lake Formation tags, row and column filters, credential vending, and the path that must stay closed
Does the principal hold SELECT through an LF-Tag
expression that matches this table and column?
columns: all except email, phone, date_of_birth
Short-lived credentials scoped to the table's
registered S3 prefix, issued to the engine only
Grant once on the tag expression, new tables inherit it.
Hybrid access mode while migrating, then remove
IAMAllowedPrincipals so IAM alone grants nothing.
key policy lets only the LF
role or an approved ETL role.
The result set leaves Lake Formation already
filtered: EU rows, no email or phone.
analyst-eu tries aws s3 cp s3://lake-curated-prod/... directly: AccessDenied. Without this deny, raw Parquet would bypass every column filter.
LF grant via AWS RAM, resource
